personality_one_liner: A high-contrast, structural, and tactical command center built for extreme outdoor visibility and uncompromised operational clarity.

spacing.rule: Use rigid grid structures with intentional visual tension. Exposed spacing and edge-to-edge containers are preferred over soft floating cards.

dont's: Never use blur or glass effects in this Brutalist personality. Rely on solid colors, high-contrast borders, and rigid geometry.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Secure entry point demanding NIK and Employee Name.

states.error: Solid red (#D30000) bottom sheet with sharp typography.

screens.layout: Oversized 'SAFETY FIRST' typography header, hard-aligned left. Edge-to-edge input fields with thick borders (1.5pt). Massive solid brand-colored submit button pinned to the bottom. No rounded corners.

screens.name: Beranda (Home)
screens.purpose: Portal landing with safety quote motif and module entry points.

states.error: Error block with a rigid retry button.

screens.layout: Top section: High-contrast safety quote in oversized display font. Mid section: Stacked, full-width modular entry cards for 'Hazard Report', 'Inspeksi', and 'Dashboard/Monitoring'. Cards use thick outlines and strong iconography. Minimal padding between sections.

screens.name: Hazard Report (List)
screens.purpose: List of logged hazards with clear status and risk visibility.

states.loading: Skeleton list rows with strict geometric lines.
states.empty: Industrial warning sign icon, 'No active hazards found.', rigid CTA 'New Report'.
states.error: Alert icon with high-contrast text and a 'Reload' button.

screens.layout: Sticky horizontal filter row (Status, Dept, Risk) at the top with sharp active states. Below, a scrollable list of edge-to-edge cards. Each card displays risk level via a sharp left-border color accent (Green/Amber/Orange/Red) and an explicit 'Open/Close' tag. A sticky bottom 'Create New' action button.

screens.name: Hazard Report (Create)
screens.purpose: Data entry form for logging a new hazard with mandatory evidence.

states.error: Inline validation messages with sharp red borders.

screens.layout: Single-column structure. Sections separated by thick 2pt black dividers. Large touch-friendly segmented controls for Risk Level (Rendah/Sedang/Tinggi/Ekstrem). Mandatory 'Before' photo upload area acts as a massive tap target. Sticky bottom 'Submit' inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Inspection (List & Detail)

states.empty: Clipboard icon, 'No inspections logged.', 'Start Inspection' CTA.

screens.layout: List: Table-like rows grouped by Inspection Type with Approved/Pending status flags. Detail: A brutalist header block for metadata, followed by a raw data table for observation rows. 'Generate PDF' action pinned.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.layout: Top strip: 4 compact KPI tiles (Total, Open, Close, Total Inspeksi) using monospace digits. Below: Stacked charts (Hazard by Dept, Risk Level, Category, Monthly Trend) using sharp SVG bars/lines. Strong contrasting background blocks for each chart.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the 5 Brutalist Mobile personality: use 0px border radius everywhere. Everything is a rigid block.
Do NOT use glassmorphism or blur effects. Surfaces must be solid with high contrast borders.
Use Archivo for display headers and IBM Plex Sans for body/UI. If available, use a monospace font (like IBM Plex Mono) for numeric KPIs, dates, and risk levels to enhance the tactical feel.
Risk Levels must map to specific colors: Rendah (success/Green), Sedang (warning/Amber), Tinggi (brandPrimary/Orange), Ekstrem (error/Red). Open status maps to error, Close maps to success.
Borders should be used structurally. Use thick borders (1pt or 1.5pt) to define cards and sections instead of soft shadows. Shadow tier is 0.
Ensure 'Before/After' photo upload components are massive, high-contrast tap targets, strictly rectangular.
Ensure all buttons are sticky at the bottom of forms/lists using KeyboardAvoidingView and absolute positioning where necessary to avoid scrolling past the CTA.
All image backgrounds must use the mandatory gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (top -> bottom, transparent -> 70% surfaceInverse) if text is rendered on top.
Zero tolerance for blue or purple accents. Keep to the strict industrial orange, black, white, and semantic colors.
